## I move between research, building, and explanation.

Across financial-literacy fieldwork, investment software, multilingual writing, and football, I keep returning to the same challenge: understand how decisions emerge from larger systems—and make the reasoning visible to others.
:::

<p class="eyebrow">Away from the desk</p>

## Some of my best classrooms have had no blackboard.

Football taught me to read movement before intervening. Long drives to training became conversations with my father about work, history, business, and the future. Travel gives me another version of the same lesson: pay attention before reaching a conclusion.

[Visit Elsewhere](elsewhere-en.qmd){.card-link}
:::

::: {.personal-aside}
> “Can I understand this deeply enough to explain it simply?”

<p>This is the question I return to—whether I am studying a market, designing software, or revising a paragraph.</p>
:::
